item: R689 follow-ups: repair stop kept through the gate wait, fixed-word failure, stopped log, pool-reaper docstring
summary: (2) stated, not changed: the repair is a registry job registered cancellable=False (its switch is never cut halfway); the lifespan raises its own stop flag before the stop-all, which then waits for it, pinned by a test. (8) the stopped log says a fresh copy is removed and made again, a resume or finish keeps its finished copy. (7) terminate_live_pools' docstring describes the R689 shutdown order; indexer pins re-recorded --same. (2b) the copy cleared its stop after the write gate's unbounded wait, so a shutdown's stop landing there was wiped; it is now cleared once before the job starts. Row 9: a failed repair raised the driver's error as it came; it now raises words of ours from None (a file error keeps class, number and file name).
